svg.title: Advanced Image Sensor Interface v3.1.0 System Architecture
svg.desc: Layered architecture diagram covering sensor input, multi-protocol transport, cross-cutting integrity and security, AI/ML enhancement, calibration, signal processing, multi-sensor synchronization, GPU acceleration, power and performance management, outputs, and testing.
svg.text: Advanced Image Sensor Interface v3.2.0 — System Architecture
Multi-Protocol AI/ML Camera Interface Framework │ MIPI CSI-2 · CoaXPress CXP-12 · GigE Vision RoCE · USB3 Vision
── Layer 1: Multi-Protocol Transport Layer (ProtocolSelector → ProtocolBase → StreamingProtocolBase) ──
Dynamic selection by: bandwidth · distance · power · latency
── Layer 2: Cross-Cutting Concerns (Data Integrity · Security · Configuration · Error Handling) ──
• Silent Failure docs in all processors
• AI-based denoising with Gaussian filter & adaptive strength
• _ai_edge_preservation(): Sobel edge detection & adaptive alpha blending
• estimate_noise_level(): Laplacian & local variance & gradient (3 features)
• train_on_image(): online learning with clean/noisy pairs
• Online color matrix adaptation (3×3 matrix with EMA)
✦ Online adaptation with measured color patches
• send_data(): burst & compression & transfer time sim
✦ Custom driver extension pattern for MIPI
── Layer 4: Neural Calibration Tuner & Signal Processing (v3.1.0) ──
• AI pipeline: adaptive HDR on GPU
• Auto CPU fallback if GPU unavailable
── Layer 6: Power Management · Performance · Neural Calibration · Buffer Mgmt ──
• Metrics: SNR / DR / Color Acc / Throughput
• Metrics: SNR / DR / ΔE / FPS / Power
• Feature Extraction: Sobel & Harris & FFT & Laplacian
── Layer 7: Output · Calibration DB · Performance Metrics · Testing ──
• CalibrationResult: K, D, R, T, RMS, size
• AI/ML tests: noise, quality, neural tuner
⚠ SILENT FAILURE BEHAVIOR: SignalProcessor/HDRProcessor/RAWProcessor return None/fallback on errors — check logs for ERROR level
ErrorHandling: SensorError hierarchy · Circuit Breaker · Retry & Jitter · Monitoring · Recovery
